ADVISORY BOARD AGREEMENT

This Advisory Board Agreement is entered into as of March 23, 2026 between Fennel Robotics, Inc. (the "Company") and Dr. Alan Greer (the "Advisor").

1. Role. Advisor will join the Company's advisory board and will be available to the Company's founders from time to time.

2. Equity. The Company will grant Advisor a stock option in an amount to be agreed.

3. Publicity. The Company may list Advisor's name and biography on its website.

4. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California.

FENNEL ROBOTICS, INC.

Name: Mira Castellan
Title: Chief Executive Officer
